challenge.method: I checked the vendor mirror’s release stamp and read the conformance appendix’s opening, feature coverage and cautions. I tested whether those passages describe the engine as a language or claim exact conformance. https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/d7ec59a63d745ba74fba0e280bbf85dc6d1caa3e
challenge.results: The 17.0 appendix describes SQL features the implementation supports, including cases with different syntax or function, and frames its feature lists as approximate. The catalog identity describes the PostgreSQL SQL dialect.

limitations: Active records the catalog identity lifecycle. The SQL documentation describes the vendor’s 17.0 SQL surface.
The classification concerns the SQL dialect and excludes separate procedural languages and the engine product identity.
